notes.title: Developer Note 22
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are the ZGGAME Development Team.

First of all, thank you to all the Brawlers who have been keeping up with the game's recent developments. Welcome to this issue of our developer notes, where we're excited to share our recent development progress and optimizations.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Future Explorations[/h2]

[b]New Mode:[/b]
The new mode is still under intensive development. For various reasons, it could not be launched this season, but we will do our best to speed up development and hope to let everyone experience it as soon as possible.

[b]New Branch:[/b]
To bring more diversity and choice to the meta, we are conceptualizing a new branch. It is currently still in the design phase, and we will, as always, strive to release this new content as soon as we can while ensuring its quality.

[b]Memory Optimization:[/b]
Last month, we dedicated significant effort to optimizing memory usage and compatibility issues. After the latest update, some players have reported that crash issues have improved. However, some players with low-spec or specific device models are still reporting crashes and lag. Therefore, we will continue our optimization efforts this month and will keep a close eye on this issue in the future.

[b]New Filter Option for the Gallery:[/b]
Since adding the manual lock feature, some players have reported that it takes a long time to find locked items when they want to unlock them. Therefore, we will be adding a filter option that, when clicked, will only display locked content in the Gallery.

[b]Treasure Selection Phase - Non-Public:[/b]
Previously, players could not see which heroes their opponents selected during the hero selection phase. After careful consideration, we have decided to apply the same principle to the treasure phase in the future. Choices will no longer be revealed to other players during the selection phase. This change is intended to prevent players who select their treasures earlier from being at a tactical disadvantage.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Community Q&A[/h2]

[b]Q: I just unlocked a new hero, but why can't I seem to roll them at the start of a match?[/b]
A: In each match, the game randomly selects 8 branches to be available for that game. Each hero is tagged with corresponding branches. If your hero's branch tags do not belong to the available branches for that match, they will not appear, no matter how many times you reroll.

[b]Q: Why does the branch targeted by the Treasure Compass sometimes change?[/b]
A: When the Seal Pocket Watch locks the branch targeted by the Treasure Compass, the system will randomly change it to another currently learnable branch to ensure the effect can trigger correctly. This is an intended mechanic and not a bug.

[b]Q: When is the iOS version coming?[/b]
A: Following the successful expansion of our Google Play Store regions in August, we have officially begun preparations for the iOS App Store launch in September. We will continue to push forward with the release while maintaining our core development schedule.

[b]Q: After using the Seal Pocket Watch to ban a branch, why does the Balance Scale still give EXP for that banned branch?[/b]
A: The Seal Pocket Watch's mechanic prevents skills from the banned branch from appearing in the Skill Store. This does not conflict with the function of the Balance Scale, so this is not a bug.

[b]Q: Can you publicly release the win rate statistics for heroes and treasures to give players a reference?[/b]
A: It's true that directly releasing this data could spark more community discussion and help players make more targeted choices. However, any meta will always have relatively strong and weak content. Releasing this data would be akin to us providing an official "best answer" for the current version, which could accelerate the solidification of the meta. As developers, this is a direction we do not wish to head in.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Other News[/h2]

We have already rolled out one round of memory optimization for the mobile version. We will continue to monitor this issue, and if problems persist, please feel free to contact us through our official community channels.

We've received many player submissions recently. Thank you all for your passion! We carefully read and screen every submission for feasible ideas. We welcome everyone to continue submitting your creative designs, so we can build a harmonious game ecosystem where developers and players create together.

[hr][/hr]
That's all for this issue of our developer notes. We welcome all discussion and feedback. See you next time

notes.title: Developer Note 21
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the ZGGAME team,

A huge thank you to all the fighters who have shown concern for the game's recent developments! Welcome to this edition of our Dev Log. We're excited to share our recent progress and upcoming optimizations with you all.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Exploring New Directions[/h2]

[b]New Game Mode:[/b]
We've received a lot of feedback from players hoping for more rounds in the Tournament. However, the Tournament is designed as a high-stakes, exclusive, and periodic event, so simply increasing its frequency isn't the best path forward. Instead, this season we are focusing on designing a new game mode. This mode will be more accessible with a lower barrier to entry, but it won't be a completely new combat system.

[b]Royale Crystal Sink:[/b]
We are still working on a plan for how players can spend their Royale Crystals this season and currently have a viable draft in place. Building a complete and sustainable sink for this currency will take time, so we will be rolling out related features and improvements gradually in future updates.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Community Q&A[/h2]

[b]Q: Can the infinite stun build be removed or nerfed?[/b]
A: Every build can have some amazing, high-impact moments when it's fully realized, and each has its own counters. The high-frequency stuns from the Ultimate-focused build are a reflection of it reaching its peak potential. That said, we are indeed re-evaluating the "feel" of playing against this and considering how to reduce player frustration. This was the same line of thinking that led to the nerf of the [b]WOLF HUNTER's[/b] ultimate, which can no longer have its stun duration extended by bonuses.

[b]Q: How about adding a small bonus for randomly selecting a Hero and Treasure?[/b]
A: We think this is an interesting and valuable suggestion. A similar system exists in DOTA 2, and we will evaluate a specific proposal and its feasibility within our current game modes in the future.

[b]Q: Can you find in-game moderators (MODs) and give them permissions to manage chat?[/b]
A: Due to our team's size, it's very difficult to actively monitor in-game chat in real-time. This is why we designed the in-game chat report button, which allows players in the lobby to collectively determine if chat content is abusive or offensive, with the system handling punishments automatically.
Granting special permissions to individual players would not only require developing a new system but would also introduce new risks, such as potential abuse of power and the challenge of managing the moderators themselves. Therefore, with our current technical limitations, we encourage players to use the existing report button to help maintain a healthy community. We truly appreciate everyone's love for the game and care for the community environment.

[b]Q: After disabling Heroes and Treasures, it takes a long time to find and re-enable them. Can you add a "re-enable all" button?[/b]
A: We will be optimizing this feature in a future update. The current plan is to add a "Disabled" filter to the collection/gallery system.

[b]Q: When will the game be available in other regions on the Google Play Store?[/b]
A: The initial review process took a significant amount of time and effort. To prioritize getting the game approved, we didn't attempt to launch in multiple regions at once. Now that we are successfully live in some regions, we will proceed with preparations for launching in Japan and Russia this season.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Other News[/h2]

We have recently launched successfully in some regions on the Google Play Store and have received some reports about compatibility issues causing crashes. We are actively analyzing this feedback to gather useful information that will help us pinpoint and fix the problem.

We have also been brainstorming some new systems for the future and will soon be using surveys to help us prioritize their development.

[hr][/hr]
That's all for this Dev Log! We welcome all your thoughts and discussions, and we'll see you in the next one!

notes.title: Penalties for Improper Point Gains
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Skill Legends Royale Players,[/h3]  

Recently, we have discovered that some players have been using improper methods to gain rank points in the game. Such behavior not only disrupts the fairness of the game but also severely impacts the experience of other players.  

Previously, we adhered to the philosophy of allowing players to enjoy the game freely with their friends, and we placed minimal restrictions on team-ups. However, as improper methods to gain points have become more prevalent, we are left with no choice but to gradually tighten the rules. Unfortunately, this has inevitably caused some inconvenience for players who are playing fairly.  

We have focused on monitoring these players, spending significant time tracking match behaviors and historical records to ensure the accuracy of our handling and to avoid affecting players engaged in normal gameplay. Our data now confirms that certain players have been engaging in abnormal behavior.  

Although we did not have explicit rules for such actions in the past, to maintain a fair gaming environment, we have decided to establish new rules and strictly enforce them effective immediately.  

[h2]Penalties[/h2]  
After thorough data analysis, we have identified players who attempted to bypass rules and repeatedly used improper methods to gain points, severely disrupting the game’s order.  

As a result, we will take the following measures:  

[list]  
[*] Deduct all rank points obtained through improper behavior.  
[*] Remove the affected players from the rank leaderboard.  
[*] If similar behavior is discovered again, the highest penalty will be a permanent account ban.  
[/list]  

We hope this action sends a clear message to all players: fairness is the core of the game. At the same time, this serves as a warning to those engaging in improper behavior — do not attempt to gain rank points through illegitimate means.  

[h3]Future Rules and Monitoring Mechanisms[/h3]  
From the date of this announcement onward, we will further refine our rules and monitoring systems to ensure that every player can enjoy the game in a fair and healthy environment.  

If you discover similar behavior, we encourage you to report it through the official community. To ensure innocent players are not affected, action will only be taken after sufficient data verification confirms the presence of violations. Thank you for your understanding.  

We sincerely thank every player who helps preserve a fair gaming environment.  

——Skill Legends Royale Team  
July 1, 2025

notes.title: Developer Note 19
notes.content:
Over the next week or so, we will focus on optimizing and resolving these issues:

1.  Heroes and Treasures from the Season Handbook are forcibly given to players, offering no choice. As players own more and more Heroes and Treasures, it becomes increasingly difficult to select specific ones.
    To address this, we will implement a two-step optimization:
    a.  Introduce a disabling feature. For each owned Hero and Treasure in the collection/gallery, a disable toggle can be set. Disabled content will not appear in your in-game choices. However, we will set a minimum required number of non-disabled Heroes and Treasures respectively; anything exceeding this minimum can be freely disabled.
    b.  Remove Royale Chests from the Season Handbook. We will add Royale Crystals, equivalent in value to the Royale Chests, to the existing handbook rewards. Heroes and Treasures that would have been in Royale Chests will be available for purchase with Royale Crystals at the start of the new season, allowing players to choose freely.

2.  Optimization for overly strong Treasure combos. We will focus on analyzing and optimizing some long-criticized Treasures, including refresh-type combos, in terms of overall strength values, maximum obtainable quantity, and appearance stage.

notes.title: Solution for Game Update Getting Stuck
notes.content:
Some players have been experiencing issues with updates getting stuck at a certain progress point after May 12th. After communicating and investigating with Steam support, we have reached a conclusion on this issue.

The problem is caused by Steam's recent implementation of a new compression format, which is incompatible with older versions of the Steam client. As a result, players who aren't using the latest version of the Steam client may experience incomplete game updates.

If you're experiencing this issue, please update to the latest version of the Steam client or uninstall and reinstall the Steam client. Feel free to contact us if you encounter any other problems.

notes.title: Developer Note 5
notes.content:
Currently, we are concentrating on developing several important features and making changes:

1. New Season
In the next season, the Ladder and the Battle Pass will be separated from the existing Royale Pass into two independent systems. Meanwhile, the season duration will be shortened from two months to one month, and the requirements for reaching the maximum level of the Ladder and the Battle Pass will be reduced accordingly. Similar to heroes, winning with different treasures each season can also speed up the process of ranking up. At the same time, the new content added in the new season will not be significantly less compared to the previous two - month seasons. After separation, once the Battle Pass reaches its maximum level, the premium Battle Pass can no longer be gifted, but the purchase price of the premium Battle Pass will be appropriately reduced.

2. Tarot Monthly Card
The Tarot Monthly Card has been criticized by some players. We will optimize it so that after purchase, there is no 30 - day expiration limit. As long as you have accumulated 30 days of logins, you will definitely be able to claim all the rewards. This optimization will be implemented soon, probably within about a week. For players who currently have the monthly card, the remaining valid days will be automatically upgraded to accumulable days after the new - version monthly card is launched.

3. Hero Skins
The pre - research has already started, and we have also tried to create some skins. They should be launched during the next season.

4. Tournament System
We are creating a once - a - week tournament system. More details will be revealed later.

5. Mobile Game
This is something that everyone is very concerned about. To ensure full interoperability and an identical experience between PC and mobile games, we have been working hard. We expect to start testing the Android version at the beginning of the new season.

6. Balance
We plan to make a balance adjustment next Monday.

If you have any ideas, feel free to leave a message.

However, your data will no longer be interoperable in other game major regions and will be frozen to the record before the update. Please choose the major region that suits you best to play the game. Wish players a happy gaming experience!

notes.title: Patch update on September 12, 2024.
notes.content:
[h3]We have added the following content:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The in-lobby customer service contact has been replaced by announcements. Now announcements can be manually opened.
[*] A new function to hide chat preview settings has been added. It is recommended for use during live streaming.
[*] A new in-game player name display setting has been added. It is recommended for use during live streaming.
[*] Chat input supports more symbols.
[*] The chat window will no longer be automatically closed at the end of battle rounds (except in the treasure phase).
[*] In-game statistics can be viewed simultaneously, making it more convenient to compare data between both sides.
[*] Updated blocked word bank.
[/olist]
[h3]We have made some adjustments to the values and mechanics in the game:[/h3]
Treasure Hunting Compass:
The compass will lock onto a playstyle for you. The treasure is hidden in the skills of this playstyle that you can learn. When learning a skill carrying the treasure, you will immediately obtain 6/8/10 => 5/7/9 random skills of this playstyle.

Scarlet Hood:
When winning the first battle after defeat, the character will recover 2/3/4 => 3/4/5 health points.
Redeemer Statue:
At the start of each round, if your character's health is below 12 points, you will additionally obtain 90/90/120 => 90/120/150 gold coins.

Emergency Medical Kit:
At the start of each round, if your character's health is below 15/10 => 12/15 points, 1/2 health points will be automatically restored.
Healing Gem (Phase 2):
When the skill shop refresh count reaches 4 => 3 times within each round, 1 health point will be restored.

Energy Harvester (Phase 3):
Each round, randomly add 5 => 4 experience points to an already learned playstyle.

Battlefield Supply Crate (Phase 3):
When the hero levels up, 1 health point is restored => When obtained, 3 health points are deducted. When the hero levels up, 2 health points are restored.

Medallion of Protection (Phase 3):
A battle loss will block 1 instance of character health deduction. The maximum number of blocks is 3 => 4.

Goblin Parts:
Carryable quantity 3 => 1.

Sin'dorei Moonstone Ring:
Carryable quantity 2 => 1.

Maximum refresh count per round 20 => 30.

We have found that some random playstyles are too imbalanced. We have made certain adjustments to the values and mechanics. Wish everyone a happy gaming experience!
Now streamers can turn off chat preview and user names in the settings and can stream with peace of mind.
We support more symbols in chat. We are deeply sorry for the previous inconveniences.
